Houses are the smaller part of Brentwood Park: 6% of its 381 listings. Condos and townhomes have their own pages, and the Brentwood Park guide covers the neighbourhood.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for detached houses that month.

blocks.text: Over 4 months 11 houses sold in Brentwood Park against an average of 19.2 listed at month end. In September the community held 4.6% of Burnaby’s 458 house listings.
Houses, condos or townhomes in Brentwood Park?

Most of Brentwood Park is attached housing: 360 condos and townhomes were listed in September against 21 houses. If you are looking at towers near the SkyTrain, start with the condo page; for ground-level homes in a complex, the townhome page.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Brentwood Park?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the reports showed 21 houses listed in Brentwood Park. That is a month-end count and moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Brentwood Park a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026 houses in Brentwood Park had a sales ratio of 14%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Brentwood Park from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 11 houses sold over those 4 months, out of 199 house sales in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Why are there so few houses for sale in Brentwood Park?
faq.a: Most of the community is condos and townhomes. In September 2026, houses were 6% of the 381 listings in Brentwood Park.

faq.q: Where are the Brentwood condos and townhomes?
faq.a: They have their own pages: the Brentwood Park condo page and the Brentwood Park townhome page. The neighbourhood guide covers the area as a whole.
